title: Easy 5 Ingredient Meat and Potato Casserole
description: A simple casserole combining ground beef, potatoes, cream of mushroom soup, milk, and cheddar cheese.

ingredients.item: Yukon gold potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced

steps: In a hot oiled pan, cook the ground beef until browned, then drain and set aside.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, layer the sliced potatoes across the bottom.
Spread the cooked ground beef evenly over the potatoes.
In a mixing bowl, whisk together the cream of mushroom soup and milk until well combined.
Pour the soup mixture evenly over the meat layer.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350°F (175°C) for about 1 hour.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the casserole and bake for an additional 5-10 minutes until melted and bubbly.
Optional: Top with chopped green onions before serving.
